metadata.name: Ecodesign for C
metadata.description: Ecodesign rules for C code: memory under control, no hidden quadratic pattern, buffered I/O, no busy waiting.

memoire.name: C — memory
memoire.description: Allocate for the real need, free on every path (RGESN Algorithms, GR491_Backend_4).

rules.title: Dynamic allocation to check
rules.description: Every allocation with no identified release path, error paths included, leaks: memory held until the process ends.
rules.recommendation: One identified free for every allocation, error paths included; reuse buffers inside loops instead of reallocating.

rules.title: Large memory area copied
rules.description: Copying a block when a pointer or an index would do doubles the memory bandwidth consumed.
rules.recommendation: Pass a pointer or an index; keep structures compact (types sized to the need, watch padding on massively instantiated structs).

rules.title: strlen() in a loop condition
rules.description: strlen re-evaluated on every iteration walks the whole string again: a quadratic loop invisible on reading.
rules.recommendation: Compute the length once before the loop.

example.good:
size_t n = strlen(s);
for (i = 0; i < n; i++)

rules.title: Repeated strcat()
rules.description: Each strcat walks the string from the start to find the terminator: quadratic concatenation.
rules.recommendation: Keep an end pointer or use memcpy with an offset; pick structures suited to the volume (hashing, binary search) rather than repeated linear scans.

io.name: C — I/O and waiting
io.description: Batch I/O, never busy wait (RGESN Backend/Hosting).

rules.title: Byte-by-byte I/O
rules.description: One system call per small unit multiplies kernel transitions: CPU spent on transfer rather than on useful work.
rules.recommendation: Use buffered, block-based I/O (fread/fwrite, writev); always close and release resources.

rules.title: Busy waiting
rules.description: A polling loop or a short sleep keeps the CPU core busy and prevents low-power states.
rules.recommendation: Block on poll/epoll/select or a condition variable; build production with -O2 and measure before hand-optimising.
